musicPreservationDescription: Protect centered instruments as much as possible; some vocal may remain when separation is ambiguous.
balancedDescription: Reduce vocals more strongly while keeping centered instruments audible and avoiding full center deletion.
strongDescription: May reduce centered instruments. Near-mono audio is protected more; Vocal 0 is maximum reduction, not guaranteed silence.
isolationDescription: Tracks the singer's pitch and removes the voice deeply, including sibilance and vocal reverb. Adds about 90 ms delay. Applies to relay and file playback; the system effect route uses Strong reduction.
